label: prf:knot-factor-borromean-composite
title: Proof of knot factor borromean composite
html:
Proof. Brunnian-ness decouples the Hecke pairings of distinct components: \chi_\lambda(\beta_{\mathrm{Bor}_k}) = \prod_{i=1}^{k}\chi_\lambda(\beta_{4_1}^{(i)}) on each Wedderburn block. Substituting in (knot factor) and applying the amphicheiral corollary (amphicheiral) componentwise gives (1 - h^2)^k. \square

Application. {}^4\mathrm{He} is a Borromean-2 configuration; its knot factor is (1 - h^2)^2, a derived value.
